Pwani · 0.125 – 0.5 acre

Swahili Coastal

The Swahili Coastal house takes the courtyard logic of Lamu and Mombasa old town and rebuilds it for a modern family: deep verandas, coral-stone screen walls, and a baraza bench that catches the sea breeze at four in the afternoon.

KES 18.5M Price band
34 wks Build time
0.125 – 0.5 acre Plot range
3/4/5 bed Plans available

Why this design

Lime-washed walls, carved doors and air that moves.

We studied eleven surviving Swahili houses between Shela and Old Town Mombasa before drawing the first plan. The lessons were consistent: shade beats air conditioning, a courtyard cools every room that opens onto it, and a carved door is a piece of engineering as much as decoration. Every TRIXX Swahili Coastal home is oriented so the long veranda faces the prevailing monsoon wind, which drops indoor temperatures by 4 to 6 degrees before any mechanical cooling runs.
